title: Use Power Platform data policies to govern Copilot Studio connectors
problem: Agents can connect to external services and leak data.
steps: Power Platform admin center > Security > Data and privacy > Data policy > + New policy.
Classify connectors into Business, Non-business, and Blocked.
Use the Copilot Studio connectors (e.g. 'Chat without Microsoft Entra ID authentication in Copilot Studio', Direct Line and other publishing channels, knowledge sources) to block risky use cases.
Apply to all environments, with exceptions for dev.
pitfalls: Data policies only apply to Power Platform; agents in other platforms need other controls.
New Copilot Studio connectors often land in the default Non-business group — check before you block that group.

sources.title: Configure data policies for agents (Copilot Studio)
